query:
SELECT t.team_id, t.puzzle_id, u.urole,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM rb_team_member tm
                WHERE tm.team_id = t.team_id
                AND tm.user_id = u.id
            ) AS is_member
        FROM rb_ticket t
        JOIN rb_user u ON u.id = $2
        WHERE t.id = $1;
